steps.note: Open the existing prepared event rather than creating or searching for another event.
Enable the required eRFX project capability before accessing the event.
Open the stage Settings action that recreates the event.
Verify that the recreate flow exposes its Create Order action.
Confirm creation of the recreated event.
Verify that the new event opens in the create flow.
Check that the resulting create screen still identifies the auction event type.
Verify that recreating the event did not produce an application error.
